first.rationale: The immediate competitive loss is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, and prior evidence indicates targeted pricing lifted both acquisition and revenue in that segment. I would verify that result alongside onboarding evidence before committing, because discounts can erode willingness to pay or attract lower-quality accounts; the onboarding decline remains a credible competing cause of weaker qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and the verified prior result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than only acquisition. The verified pricing result is unsuitable because its 30-day retention decline indicates poor downstream value. Monitor activation, retention, and qualified revenue by cohort to ensure simplification does not reduce account quality.
